title: Don’t Be a “People Pleaser”
synopsis: Li Xiang likes helping people out, but is there such thing as being overly kind?

fullText.simplified:
拒做“烂好人”

    “烂好人”是个贬义词，说的是那种有求必应，不懂拒绝的人。表面上看起来，“烂好人”人缘不错，很多人都喜欢他们。实际上，他们常常会因为自己的不拒绝带来很多麻烦。
    李想就是这样一个人。他是同事、朋友、邻居眼中的“大好人”，不管别人请他帮什么样的忙，他都来者不拒。但是在李想老婆眼中他却是个“烂好人”，觉得他没有分寸感，没有原则，只知道说“好好好，行行行”。他老婆不止一次地提醒李想不能再做“烂好人”了，否则早晚会有麻烦的。不过李想不听，甚至觉得老婆无理取闹。这不，麻烦来了。
    李想家隔壁住着一对夫妻，男的姓张，女的姓王。因为他们年纪都比李想小，所以李想管他们叫“小张”和“小王”，他们叫李想“李哥”。小张常年在外地出差，一年到头回不了两次家。小王自己一个人带着个三岁大的孩子在家生活。有时候，一些重活什么的小王会找李想帮忙。有几次，已经很晚了，小王来李想家找李想帮忙，李想的老婆都替李想拒绝了。他老婆给的原因是：太晚了，不方便，明天白天再让李想过去。李想觉得老婆的做法不合适：都是邻居，帮个忙是举手之劳，没什么大不了的。为了这个，他还和老婆大吵了几次。他老婆一生气就回了娘家。李想觉得没面子，也不去接老婆。
    这天，小王又来找李想。小王说孩子幼儿园要举办亲子运动会，别人都有爸爸去参加，自己老公回不来，她怕孩子不高兴，想让李想假装孩子的爸爸和她一起去参加。李想虽然觉得这么做不合适，但是不好意思拒绝就同意了，没想到这一次惹出了麻烦。
    小张在电话里听说了孩子运动会的消息，为了给老婆和孩子一个惊喜，就悄悄地请假回了家。结果幼儿园门口的保安不让小张进，说小张冒充孩子家长，要打电话报警。小张和保安的吵闹声吸引了很多人。小王和李想听到吵闹声也来到了门口。生气的小张一看到李想和小王就更生气了，他大声说：“好哇，怪不得小王总是说什么让我安心工作，不让我回来，原来你们早就在一起了，连家长会都一起来参加，你们太过分了。”李想想跟小张解释一下，但是小张在气头上根本听不进去，非要跟小王离婚不可。
    李想没办法了，只好去老婆的娘家接回了老婆，让老婆去跟小张解释清楚。老婆指着李想的脑门儿说：“你个烂好人，这种忙你也帮，你真是糊涂。”李想知道理亏，低着头一句话也说不出来。李想老婆去小张家解释了半天终于把事情说明白了。误会虽然解开了，但是李想和小张这两家人的关系却再也回不去了。小张觉得丢人，李想觉得尴尬。没过多长时间，小张一家就搬走了。
    吃一堑长一智。经过这次的事情，李想总算长教训了。他再也不做“烂好人”了。
fullText.traditional:
拒做“爛好人”

    “爛好人”是個貶義詞，說的是那種有求必應，不懂拒絕的人。表面上看起來，“爛好人”人緣不錯，很多人都喜歡他們。實際上，他們常常會因為自己的不拒絕帶來很多麻煩。
    李想就是這樣一個人。他是同事、朋友、鄰居眼中的“大好人”，不管別人請他幫什麼樣的忙，他都來者不拒。但是在李想老婆眼中他卻是個“爛好人”，覺得他沒有分寸感，沒有原則，只知道說“好好好，行行行”。他老婆不止一次地提醒李想不能再做“爛好人”了，否則早晚會有麻煩的。不過李想不聽，甚至覺得老婆無理取鬧。這不，麻煩來了。
    李想家隔壁住著一對夫妻，男的姓張，女的姓王。因為他們年紀都比李想小，所以李想管他們叫“小張”和“小王”，他們叫李想“李哥”。小張常年在外地出差，一年到頭回不了兩次家。小王自己一個人帶著個三歲大的孩子在家生活。有時候，一些重活甚麼的小王會找李想幫忙。有幾次，已經很晚了，小王來李想家找李想幫忙，李想的老婆都替李想拒絕了。他老婆給的原因是：太晚了，不方便，明天白天再讓李想過去。李想覺得老婆的做法不合適：都是鄰居，幫個忙是舉手之勞，沒什麼大不了的。為了這個，他還和老婆大吵了幾次。他老婆一生氣就回了娘家。李想覺得沒面子，也不去接老婆。
    這天，小王又來找李想。小王說孩子幼兒園要舉辦親子運動會，別人都有爸爸去參加，自己老公回不來，她怕孩子不高興，想讓李想假裝孩子的爸爸和她一起去參加。李想雖然覺得這麼做不合適，但是不好意思拒絕就同意了，沒想到這一次惹出了麻煩。
    小張在電話裡聽說了孩子運動會的消息，為了給老婆和孩子一個驚喜，就悄悄地請假回了家。結果幼兒園門口的保安不讓小張進，說小張冒充孩子家長，要打電話報警。小張和保安的吵鬧聲吸引了很多人。小王和李想聽到吵鬧聲也來到了門口。生氣的小張一看到李想和小王就更生氣了，他大聲說：“好哇，怪不得小王總是說什麼讓我安心工作，不讓我回來，原來你們早就在一起了，連家長會都一起來參加，你們太過分了。”李想想跟小張解釋一下，但是小張在氣頭上根本聽不進去，非要跟小王離婚不可。
    李想沒辦法了，只好去老婆的娘家接回了老婆，讓老婆去跟小張解釋清楚。老婆指著李想的腦門儿說：“你個爛好人，這種忙你也幫，你真是糊塗。”李想知道理虧，低著頭一句話也說不出來。李想老婆去小張家解釋了半天終於把事情說明白了。誤會雖然解開了，但是李想和小張這兩家人的關係卻再也回不去了。小張覺得丟人，李想覺得尷尬。沒過多長時間，小張一家就搬走了。
    吃一塹長一智。經過這次的事情，李想總算長教訓了。他再也不做“爛好人”了。

sentences.pinyin: jié guǒ yòu ér yuán mén kǒu de bǎo ān bú ràng xiǎo zhāng jìn
sentences.english: In order to give his wife and child a surprise, he secretly took time off work and returned home.

sentences.simplified: 说小张冒充孩子家长，要打电话报警。
sentences.traditional: 說小張冒充孩子家長，要打電話報警。
sentences.pinyin: shuō xiǎo zhāng mào chōng hái zi jiā zhǎng yào dǎ diàn huà bào jǐng
sentences.english: However, the security guard at the kindergarten entrance did not allow Little Zhang to enter.

sentences.simplified: 小张和保安的吵闹声吸引了很多人。
sentences.traditional: 小張和保安的吵鬧聲吸引了很多人。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo zhāng hé bǎo ān de chǎo nào shēng xī yǐn le hěn duō rén
sentences.english: He said that Little Zhang was impersonating a parent and that he would call the police.

sentences.simplified: 小王和李想听到吵闹声也来到了门口。
sentences.traditional: 小王和李想聽到吵鬧聲也來到了門口。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo wáng hé lǐ xiǎng tīng dào chǎo nào shēng yě lái dào le mén kǒu
sentences.english: The commotion between Little Zhang and the security guard drew a lot of attention.

sentences.simplified: 生气的小张一看到李想和小王就更生气了，
sentences.traditional: 生氣的小張一看到李想和小王就更生氣了，
sentences.pinyin: shēng qì de xiǎo zhāng yí kàn dào lǐ xiǎng hé xiǎo wáng jiù gèng shēng qì le
sentences.english: Little Wang and Li Xiang also heard the commotion and came to the entrance.

sentences.simplified: 他大声说：“好哇，怪不得小王总是说什么让我安心工作，不让我回来，
sentences.traditional: 他大聲說：“好哇，怪不得小王總是說什麼讓我安心工作，不讓我回來，
sentences.pinyin: tā dà shēng shuō hǎo wa guài bu de xiǎo wáng zǒng shì shuō shén me ràng wǒ ān xīn gōng zuò bú ràng wǒ huí lái
sentences.english: As soon as the angry Little Zhang saw Li Xiang and Little Wang, he became even more angry.

sentences.simplified: 原来你们早就在一起了，
sentences.traditional: 原來你們早就在一起了，
sentences.pinyin: yuán lái nǐ men zǎo jiù zài yì qǐ le
sentences.english: He said loudly, “Well, no wonder Little Wang always tells me to concentrate on my work and not come back.”

sentences.simplified: 连家长会都一起来参加，你们太过分了。”
sentences.traditional: 連家長會都一起來參加，你們太過分了。”
sentences.pinyin: lián jiā zhǎng huì dōu yì qǐ lái cān jiā nǐ men tài guò fèn le
sentences.english: So it turns out that you two have already been together for a long time.

sentences.simplified: 李想想跟小张解释一下，但是小张在气头上根本听不进去，非要跟小王离婚不可。
sentences.traditional: 李想想跟小張解釋一下，但是小張在氣頭上根本聽不進去，非要跟小王離婚不可。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ xiǎng xiǎng gēn xiǎo zhāng jiě shì yí xià dàn shì xiǎo zhāng zài qì tóu shàng gēn běn tīng bú jìn qù fēi yào gēn xiǎo wáng lí hūn bù kě
sentences.english: So you’ve been together all this time, even attending parent meetings together. You’ve gone too far.
Li Xiang wanted to explain things to Little Zhang, but Little Zhang was too furious to listen. He was set on divorcing Little Wang.

sentences.simplified: 李想没办法了，只好去老婆的娘家接回了老婆，
sentences.traditional: 李想沒辦法了，只好去老婆的娘家接回了老婆，
sentences.pinyin: lǐ xiǎng méi bàn fǎ le zhǐ hǎo qù lǎo po de niáng jia jiē huí le lǎo po

sentences.simplified: 让老婆去跟小张解释清楚。
sentences.traditional: 讓老婆去跟小張解釋清楚。
sentences.pinyin: ràng lǎo po qù gēn xiǎo zhāng jiě shì qīng chu
sentences.english: Li Xiang was at a loss, so he had no choice but to go to his wife’s parents’ home to bring her back, ..

sentences.simplified: 老婆指着李想的脑门儿说：“你个烂好人，这种忙你也帮，你真是糊涂。”
sentences.traditional: 老婆指著李想的腦門儿說：“你個爛好人，這種忙你也幫，你真是糊塗。”
sentences.pinyin: lǎo po zhǐ zhe lǐ xiǎng de nǎo mén'r shuō nǐ ge làn hǎo rén zhè zhǒng máng nǐ yě bāng nǐ zhēn shi hú tu
sentences.english: .. and let her wife explain everything clearly to Little Zhang.

sentences.simplified: 李想知道理亏，低着头一句话也说不出来。
sentences.traditional: 李想知道理虧，低著頭一句話也說不出來。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ xiǎng zhī dào lǐ kuī dī zhe tóu yí jù huà yě shuō bù chu lai
sentences.english: His wife pointed at Li Xiang’s forehead and said, “You ‘people pleaser’, even helping with something like this. You really are silly.”

sentences.simplified: 李想老婆去小张家解释了半天终于把事情说明白了。
sentences.traditional: 李想老婆去小張家解釋了半天終於把事情說明白了。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ xiǎng lǎo po qù xiǎo zhāng jiā jiě shì le bàn tiān zhōng yú bǎ shì qing shuō míng bai le
sentences.english: Li Xiang knew he was in the wrong. He bowed his head, unable to utter a single word.

sentences.simplified: 误会虽然解开了，
sentences.traditional: 誤會雖然解開了，
sentences.pinyin: wù huì suī rán jiě kāi le
sentences.english: Li Xiang’s wife went to Little Zhang’s house, and after explaining for a long time, she was finally able to make things clear.

sentences.simplified: 但是李想和小张这两家人的关系却再也回不去了。
sentences.traditional: 但是李想和小張這兩家人的關係卻再也回不去了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì lǐ xiǎng hé xiǎo zhāng zhè liǎng jiā rén de guān xi què zài yě huí bú qù le
sentences.english: Although the misunderstanding was resolved, ..

sentences.simplified: 小张觉得丢人，李想觉得尴尬。没过多长时间，小张一家就搬走了。
sentences.traditional: 小張覺得丟人，李想覺得尷尬。沒過多長時間，小張一家就搬走了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo zhāng jué de diū rén lǐ xiǎng jué de gān gà méi guò duō cháng shí jiān xiǎo zhāng yì jiā jiù bān zǒu le
sentences.english: .. the relationship between Li Xiang’s and Little Zhang’s families could never go back to what it was before.
Little Zhang felt embarrassed, and Li Xiang felt awkward. Not long after, Little Zhang’s family moved away.

sentences.simplified: 吃一堑长一智。经过这次的事情，李想总算长教训了。他再也不做“烂好人”了。
sentences.traditional: 吃一塹長一智。經過這次的事情，李想總算長教訓了。他再也不做“爛好人”了。
sentences.pinyin: chī yí qiàn zhǎng yí zhì jīng guò zhè cì de shì qing lǐ xiǎng zǒng suàn zhǎng jiào xun le tā zài yě bú zuò làn hǎo rén le

sentence_translations: Don’t Be a “People Pleaser”
“People pleaser” is a term with negative connotations, referring to those who respond to every request and don’t know how to refuse.
On the surface, “people pleasers” seemed to be quite popular and liked by many people.
In reality, they often bring a lot of trouble upon themselves due to their inability to refuse.
Li Xiang is such a person. He is a “great guy’” in the eyes of his colleagues, friends, and neighbors.
No matter what kind of favor others ask of him, he never refuses.
However, in Li Xiang’s wife’s eyes, he is a “people pleaser”.
She feels that he has no sense of boundaries or principles and only knows how to say “Okay, okay, okay” and “Sure, sure, sure”.
Li Xiang’s wife reminded him more than once not to continue being a “people pleaser”.
Otherwise, he will get into trouble sooner or later.
However, Li Xiang didn’t listen and even thought that his wife was making a fuss about nothing.
And just like that, trouble came.
A couple lived next door to Li Xiang”s house. The husband’s surname was Zhang, and the wife’s surname was Wang.
Because they were both younger than Li Xiang, Li Xiang called them “Little Zhang” and “Little Wang”.
They called Li Xiang “Brother Li”.
Little Zhang was often away on business and could only return home a couple of times a year.
Little Wang lived at home, taking care of a 3-year-old child.
Sometimes, Little Wang would ask Li Xiang for help with some difficult tasks.
A few times, Little Wang came to Li Xiang’s house to ask for his help when it was already very late.
Li Xiang’s wife always refused on his behalf.
His wife’s reason was: It’s too late, and it’s inconvenient. She would let Li Xiang go over to help in the daytime tomorrow.
Li Xiang felt that his wife’s approach was inappropriate:
They are neighbors. Helping out is no trouble at all. It isn’t a big deal.
Because of this, he had several big arguments with his wife.
When his wife got angry, she would return to her parents’ home.
Li Xiang felt it was embarrassing, so he didn’t go to fetch his wife.
On this day, Little Wang came to see Li Xiang again.
Little Wang said that her child’s kindergarten was holding a family sports day.
Everyone else had their fathers participating, but her own husband couldn’t make it back.
She was afraid that her child would be sad, so she wanted Li Xiang to pretend to be her child’s dad and attend with her.
Although Li Xiang felt that it was inappropriate to do so, he felt bad about refusing and agreed.
He didn’t anticipate that this would lead to trouble.
Little Zhang heard about his child’s sports day over the phone.
In order to give his wife and child a surprise, he secretly took time off work and returned home.
However, the security guard at the kindergarten entrance did not allow Little Zhang to enter.
He said that Little Zhang was impersonating a parent and that he would call the police.
The commotion between Little Zhang and the security guard drew a lot of attention.
Little Wang and Li Xiang also heard the commotion and came to the entrance.
As soon as the angry Little Zhang saw Li Xiang and Little Wang, he became even more angry.
He said loudly, “Well, no wonder Little Wang always tells me to concentrate on my work and not come back.”
So it turns out that you two have already been together for a long time.
So you’ve been together all this time, even attending parent meetings together. You’ve gone too far.
Li Xiang wanted to explain things to Little Zhang, but Little Zhang was too furious to listen. He was set on divorcing Little Wang.
Li Xiang was at a loss, so he had no choice but to go to his wife’s parents’ home to bring her back, ..
.. and let her wife explain everything clearly to Little Zhang.
His wife pointed at Li Xiang’s forehead and said, “You ‘people pleaser’, even helping with something like this. You really are silly.”
Li Xiang knew he was in the wrong. He bowed his head, unable to utter a single word.
Li Xiang’s wife went to Little Zhang’s house, and after explaining for a long time, she was finally able to make things clear.
Although the misunderstanding was resolved, ..
.. the relationship between Li Xiang’s and Little Zhang’s families could never go back to what it was before.
Little Zhang felt embarrassed, and Li Xiang felt awkward. Not long after, Little Zhang’s family moved away.
You live and you learn. After this incident, Li Xiang learned his lesson at last.  He won’t ever be a “people pleaser” again.
